verdict.rationale: Cursor documents running many agents in parallel: cloud agents with no limit, worktrees so several agents can work on one repo without conflicts, and parallel subagents. It also names a dedicated Agents Window and cursor.com/agents as places to launch and manage these agents, and the Cloud Agents API supports listing, streaming, cancelling and archiving runs. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the Agents Window as a unified session-management view (monitoring, switching, and reviewing sessions side by side), and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-session management.
